versions.changelog:
Initial release of ai-video-from-bilibili.

- Introduces the ability to save AI video generation summaries to the knowledge base.
- Triggered by the phrase "ai video" in user speech or text.
- Implements linkage with capability_executor, skill_evolver (MetaClaw), and seal_coevolution (SEAL) for reporting and tracking.
- Integrates knowledge and examples from multiple Bilibili sources, covering AI video generation tools, tutorials, and use cases.
- Supports both English and Chinese usage instructions.
